title: Define custom starting positions and position editor
source: The owner requested custom starting positions during the move-contract discussion in the child thread.
pendingQuestion: Should players be able to arrange pieces visually and paste a FEN position?
recommendation: Support both a visual position editor and FEN import.
acceptedScope: The MVP includes human-selected starting positions for play against a model opponent. Chess.com and Lichess are familiar examples, without a decision to copy their full feature sets.
terminalSummary:
Recorded: unfinished games can continue with a new model. Recorded losses stay final, with further play treated as practice.

I added [custom starting positions](https://linear.app/kamkm/issue/KHA-19/define-custom-starting-positions-and-position-editor) to the MVP plan.

Should players be able to **arrange pieces visually and paste a FEN position**? I recommend supporting both.
